relationships.evidence_quote: FIRRE bound to HMGB1 and negatively regulated its protein level

relationships.subject: lncRNA FIRRE
relationships.evidence_quote: The ubiquitination degradation of HMGB1 was promoted by FIRRE silence.

relationships.subject: lncRNA FIRRE
relationships.evidence_quote: The concentrations of IL-1β, TNF-α, and IL-6 from LPS-induced microglial cells were reduced by FIRRE knockdown.

relationships.subject: lncRNA FIRRE
relationships.evidence_quote: The in vivo experiment showed that FIRRE knockdown alleviated neuropathic pain of CCI female mice.

key_findings: FIRRE is upregulated in spinal cord of female CCI mice and LPS-induced microglia
FIRRE knockdown reduces HMGB1 and microglial cytokine release, relieving neuropathic pain
